name: visio-mcp
description: Visio automation for AI assistants through MCP - manage pages, shapes, text, ShapeSheet cells, stencils, and live visible workflows on Windows with Microsoft Visio installed

scripts.clean: cd .. && dotnet build-server shutdown && dotnet clean src/VisioMcp.McpServer/VisioMcp.McpServer.csproj -c Release -nodeReuse:false
scripts.build:mcp-server: npm run clean && npm run clean:bin && cd .. && dotnet publish src/VisioMcp.McpServer/VisioMcp.McpServer.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -p:PublishTrimmed=false -p:PublishReadyToRun=false -p:NuGetAudit=false -nodeReuse:false -o vscode-extension/bin --verbosity minimal
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:mcp-server && npm run copy:skills && npm run copy:changelog && npm run compile
